bio: The comfortable and elegant setting of this century-old building has been rejuvenated by the recent arrival of Élise and Paul Fabuel. He is the young chef who appeared on French TV's Objectif Top Chef, as well as completing stints at À Table in Metz and À l'Échevin in Colmar. Here, he serves up an attractive seasonal menu, eg a medley of pumpkin, roast chestnuts, Iberian ham and porcini, or turbot a la plancha, radishes, courgettes with mint and sauce vierge....
